summary: ACRES Commercial Realty Corp. filed an 8-K reporting a registered direct offering of 2,220,000 shares of its 8.625% Series C Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock at $23.75 per share, raising approximately $52.75 million gross. The offering closed on August 12, 2026, under an existing Form S-3 shelf, with Seaport Global Securities LLC as placement agent. The shares are a pre-existing security class, and terms were not revised. This is a routine equity capital raise, not a special situation, and does not involve a merger, tender offer, restructuring, or other transformative corporate event.
